registration.termsSubtitle: USER TERMS, SAFETY, SECURITY, PAYMENT & RESPONSIBLE USE POLICY
registration.intro: S-MAHII is a digital platform that connects people with professionals, artisans, traders, businesses, companies and institutions for verification, discovery, communication, marketplace access and booking. S-MAHII does not authorize or support terrorism, fraud, violence, harassment or any unlawful activity.
registration.p1_text: S-MAHII provides digital tools for registration, verification, professional and business discovery, communication, marketplace access, service requests, booking and payment. The platform is built for lawful, beneficial connections only.
registration.p2_text: Where a registration, subscription or access fee applies, it helps fund verification, Agent and Coordinator operations, security, customer support and platform maintenance. Fees may vary by country, account type, business size and level of access, and are always shown clearly before you pay.
registration.p3_title: 3. Pay Only Through Official S-MAHII Channels
registration.p3_text: Always pay through the official S-MAHII payment system. Never send money directly to an individual — including anyone claiming to be an S-MAHII employee, Agent or Coordinator — through a personal bank account, wallet, phone number or payment link. Report any such request immediately.
registration.p4_text: Once a payment is successfully completed, it is generally non-refundable, except where required by an applicable S-MAHII policy, applicable law, a technical error or a duplicate payment. Review your plan and amount carefully before confirming.
registration.p5_text: Having an account does not automatically make someone trustworthy. Before an important transaction, check the person's profile and verification status, and confirm their identity through their official S-MAHII account — including if they call you claiming to know you from the platform.
registration.p6_text: If you meet someone from S-MAHII in person, choose a safe, appropriate location, tell a trusted person where you're going, avoid sharing sensitive information unnecessarily, and leave immediately and report it if anything feels unsafe.
registration.p7_text: You must never use S-MAHII for terrorism, violence, fraud, identity theft, harassment, exploitation, trafficking or any other unlawful activity. Accounts involved in prohibited activity may be restricted, suspended, terminated and reported to the relevant authorities.
registration.p8_text: Report suspicious, fraudulent or dangerous activity through S-MAHII's official reporting channel — we may review relevant account, verification and activity records to support genuine reports. You remain responsible for your own decisions and conduct when using the platform. S-MAHII is not a substitute for emergency or law-enforcement services — contact them directly if you are in immediate danger.
registration.agree: I have read and agree to the S-MAHII Terms, Safety and Payment Policy.
